title: BACHELOR PARTY SAUNA EXPERIENCE "BACHELOR PACK"

belief.title: Folk belief:
belief.text: The sauna is the farmer's doctor. Were it not for the sauna and the radish, doctors would ride in golden carriages.

description1: Bachelor parties came to Latvia from abroad, and they have quickly become a firm part of the run-up to a wedding.
description2: By tradition, a bachelor party is a gathering of the groom-to-be's friends – a day to celebrate in style and do something unusual and exciting together.
description3: At SaimniekaPirts, the groom's friends book the sauna as part of the bachelor party: to relax together, try something new and send the groom off into married life.

details.master: Led by one certified sauna master

includedItems: Warming up together, with a wish-making ritual for the groom;
A vibroacoustic massage with willow whisks for the groom;
A short whisking for the groom with the "shedding of the snakeskin";
The great men's whisking, just for the groom, with a dip in the pond and a rest wrapped in blankets;

additional.rental: Sauna and herbal hot tub – 18€ / h (4 h included in the price)
